name: Calculator Standard
description: Declarative quality standard for future calculator assets.
acceptanceCriteria: legal dependencies are typed and auditable when required

entryExperience: complete hero with value promise and output preview
formJourney: guided classes include context and proportional progression
resultExperience: primary result is distinguishable from secondary metrics
meaning and scenario context are understandable without returning to form
class-required interpretation, limitations and next steps are present
calculationMemory: non-trivial reports include inputs, premises, intermediates, operations, rounding, final result and limitations
memory and primary result are equivalent
content: main editorial content contains 800 to 1200 useful words after exclusions
methodology and FAQ are visible before calculation
FAQ matches FAQPage exactly when used
actions: copy, print and download have distinct behaviors
print uses an isolated adaptive report
download uses an approved structured document
recommendations: stable canonical slot follows interpretation and precedes memory
state is one of the four canonical states
rendering requires approved product source and eligibility
brand: institutional blue is the mandatory default primary theme
any variation has documented approval and render evidence
freshness: visible Atualizado em month year text matches governed metadata
adaptiveReport: all seven report declarations derive from calculator semantics
report is A4 structured selectable and viewport independent
screenshot and raster-only reports are blocked
visual: structural, design-system, quality and responsive parity assessed
small mobile, large mobile, intermediate and desktop evidence resolved
focus, error, empty and overflow states reviewed

fullStandardBlockers: false visual pass without rendered evidence
migrationNotes: Assets on v1.0 or v1.1 may migrate to v1.2 for final experience and adaptive-report requirements.
Assets migrating to v1.3 must pass the conservative migration, regression baseline and governed propagation gates.
Assets on v1.x may migrate to v2.0 only through Migration, Testing and Validation gates.

availableVersions.1.1: Canonical reference-backed experience, result, memory, visual evidence and anti-pattern enforcement.
availableVersions.1.2: Institutional theme, visible freshness, permanent content, editorial depth, canonical recommendation slot and adaptive report enforcement.
availableVersions.1.3: Conservative migration, editorial heritage preservation, baseline gating and typed governed propagation.
availableVersions.2.0: Reserved for future layout, publishing and monetization quality changes.
